description.fun: A shy little chameleon that turns invisible when it gets wet, its skin changing colour to blend in. If that fails, Sobble bursts into tears that pack the punch of 100 onions, setting everyone nearby weeping while it slips away. Its tear-like markings may come from the veiled chameleon, which drinks water that trickles down its head.
description.guide: The Water-type first partner Pokémon of Galar, from Pokémon Sword and Shield. Sobble is timid and turns invisible when wet; when frightened it cries tears that make attackers weep. It evolves into Drizzile and then Inteleon.
description.tagline: A crybaby chameleon whose tears hit like 100 onions

description.fun: Clever but deeply lazy, Drizzile would rather lay traps all around its territory than chase intruders off itself. It fights with water balloons made from moisture its palms secrete, and plans hit-and-run tactics using whatever is around it.
description.guide: The middle stage of Sobble's line. Drizzile is highly intelligent but lazy, defending its home with traps and fighting with water balloons formed from moisture in its palms.
description.tagline: A genius lizard too lazy to do more than it has to

description.fun: Galar's secret agent, in what looks like a tuxedo, with a spy's kit built in: fingertips that fire water at Mach 3, eye membranes that spot weak points and body heat, a back membrane for gliding and hidden blades in its tail. Under the polished manners it's still a bit lazy, and it slacks off when its Trainer isn't looking.
description.guide: The final evolution of Sobble and Galar's Water-type first partner, styled after a secret agent. Inteleon shoots water from its fingertips, glides on a membrane on its back and uses special eye membranes to find weak points. It has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A tuxedoed spy lizard with water pistols for fingers

description.fun: Its tail stretches over 40 metres into a sniper's tower. From the top it gauges wind and temperature with its crest and fires water at Mach 7, hitting a rolling Berry about 15 km away. It arrived with The Isle of Armor.
